subject: chemistry
title: Beaker
purpose: Holds, mixes or heats liquids approximately.
howToUse: Use for mixing and transfers; never treat its graduations as high-precision volume readings.
safety: Hot glass can look cold; use protection and avoid cracks.

subject: chemistry
title: Conical flask
purpose: Allows swirling reaction mixtures with lower splash risk.
howToUse: Set under the burette for titration while gently swirling.
safety: Do not seal during gas-producing reactions.

subject: chemistry
title: Burette
purpose: Dispenses measured liquid volume through a stopcock.
howToUse: Read the meniscus at eye level and calculate final minus initial reading.
safety: Clamp vertically; keep liquid below eye level.

subject: chemistry
title: Volumetric pipette
purpose: Transfers one accurately specified liquid volume.
howToUse: Use a pipette filler; keep pipette vertical during aspiration.
safety: Never pipette by mouth.

subject: chemistry
title: Measuring cylinder
purpose: Measures an approximate liquid volume.
howToUse: Choose a size close to target volume and read the bottom of the meniscus.
safety: Place on a level stable bench.

subject: chemistry
title: Filter funnel
purpose: Supports filter paper to separate suspended insoluble solids.
howToUse: Fold suitable filter paper; pour along a glass rod into the funnel.
safety: Filtration does not remove dissolved substances.

subject: chemistry
title: Evaporating dish
purpose: Provides a wide surface for controlled evaporation.
howToUse: Heat suitable solutions gently under teacher supervision.
safety: Treat residue and dish as hot until cooled.

subject: chemistry
title: Retort stand and clamp
purpose: Holds burettes and other equipment vertically and securely.
howToUse: Secure clamps and inspect balance before adding glassware.
safety: An unstable stand can topple or break glass.

subject: chemistry
title: Electronic balance
purpose: Measures the mass of samples.
howToUse: Tare the container and record values with appropriate precision.
safety: Do not put corrosive material directly on the pan.

subject: chemistry
title: pH meter
purpose: Estimates solution pH using calibrated electrodes.
howToUse: Rinse probe between samples and follow calibration guidance.
safety: Probe glass is fragile and readings depend on calibration.

subject: chemistry
title: Thermometer
purpose: Measures the temperature of an experiment.
howToUse: Ensure the sensor contacts the medium and use a suitable range.
safety: Do not exceed instrument rating or expose mercury devices.

subject: chemistry
title: Safety goggles
purpose: Protects eyes from splashes and flying fragments.
howToUse: Wear fitted goggles when working with chemicals or glassware.
safety: Protection is not a substitute for safe technique.

subject: physics
title: Metre rule
purpose: Measures length and displacement on a straight scale.
howToUse: Align zero mark and read with eye perpendicular to marks.
safety: Check zero error and avoid parallax.

subject: physics
title: Stopwatch
purpose: Measures elapsed time for repeated events.
howToUse: Time several complete oscillations and average the period.
safety: Human reaction time affects manual readings.

subject: physics
title: Micrometer screw gauge
purpose: Measures small diameters and thicknesses.
howToUse: Check zero offset, use ratchet gently and read sleeve and thimble.
safety: Excess pressure deforms small specimens.

subject: physics
title: Vernier calliper
purpose: Measures internal, external and depth dimensions.
howToUse: Zero the jaws and read main scale plus vernier.
safety: Avoid overtightening or sharp edges.

subject: physics
title: Ammeter
purpose: Measures current flowing through a circuit.
howToUse: Connect in series with a suitable rated range.
safety: Connecting directly across a supply can short the circuit.

subject: physics
title: Voltmeter
purpose: Measures potential difference between points.
howToUse: Connect in parallel across the component.
safety: Check polarity and rating.

subject: physics
title: DC power supply
purpose: Provides adjustable electrical potential difference.
howToUse: Begin at low voltage and increase gradually.
safety: Do not exceed safe current limits; disconnect before rewiring.

subject: physics
title: Resistor
purpose: Limits current according to its resistance.
howToUse: Choose the rated resistance and power capacity.
safety: Resistors can heat under excessive power.

subject: physics
title: Convex lens
purpose: Refracts light to form images.
howToUse: Move an object and screen to find sharp real images.
safety: Never focus direct sunlight into eyes or onto flammable surfaces.

subject: physics
title: Optical bench and screen
purpose: Supports optical alignment and receives real images.
howToUse: Align lamp, lens and screen centres along one axis.
safety: Avoid looking into intense light sources.

subject: physics
title: Pendulum bob and string
purpose: Forms a gravity-driven oscillating system.
howToUse: Set measured length from pivot to bob centre.
safety: Use a secure pivot; keep clear of the swing path.

subject: physics
title: Spring balance
purpose: Measures force through spring extension.
howToUse: Zero the instrument and read the calibrated force scale.
safety: Do not overload the spring.

subject: biology
title: Compound light microscope
purpose: Magnifies prepared specimens using eyepiece and objective lenses.
howToUse: Begin with low power, centre specimen, then move to higher magnification.
safety: Avoid forcing objective into slide.

subject: biology
title: Microscope slide
purpose: Supports thin specimens for observation.
howToUse: Place sample in liquid mount when appropriate and cover gently.
safety: Glass edges can cut.

subject: biology
title: Cover slip
purpose: Flattens wet mounts and protects the objective.
howToUse: Lower at an angle to reduce trapped air.
safety: Handle delicate glass with care.

subject: biology
title: Dropper pipette
purpose: Transfers small drops of liquids.
howToUse: Dispense clean drops without contaminating stock reagents.
safety: Avoid contact with mouth or eyes.

subject: biology
title: Forceps
purpose: Handles small samples without fingers touching them.
howToUse: Grip tissues or coverslips gently.
safety: Points may be sharp.

subject: biology
title: Scalpel
purpose: Cuts or dissects prepared materials precisely.
howToUse: Only use in a supervised, authorised practical.
safety: Sharp blade; use protective procedures.

subject: biology
title: Petri dish
purpose: Holds small specimens or prepared cultures.
howToUse: Label and observe only teacher-approved specimens.
safety: Do not open unknown microbial cultures.

subject: biology
title: Potometer
purpose: Estimates water uptake by a cut shoot.
howToUse: Track bubble displacement along capillary with measured dimensions.
safety: Leaks and tissue storage affect the estimate.

subject: biology
title: Specimen jar
purpose: Keeps labelled biological specimens contained.
howToUse: Label specimen, preservative and date.
safety: Do not open unknown preservatives.

subject: biology
title: Hand lens
purpose: Provides low-power magnification of visible specimens.
howToUse: Hold near eye and adjust working distance.
safety: Never use to look at the sun.

subject: biology
title: Test tube and rack
purpose: Holds small reagent samples safely.
howToUse: Keep upright in rack and direct mouth away during heating.
safety: Hot glass and reagents may cause injury.

subject: biology
title: Dissecting tray
purpose: Provides stable work surface for authorised specimens.
howToUse: Arrange tools and labels before supervised investigation.
safety: Follow hygiene and disinfection procedures.

subject: agriculture
title: Hoe
purpose: Breaks shallow soil and assists weeding.
howToUse: Keep a safe working distance and maintain the handle.
safety: Sharp metal head can injure feet or bystanders.

subject: agriculture
title: Spade
purpose: Lifts and turns soil or compost.
howToUse: Use the edge to cut and lever soil appropriately.
safety: Use safe lifting posture.

subject: agriculture
title: Rake
purpose: Levels soil and gathers residues.
howToUse: Pull across prepared soil or beds.
safety: Store with tines turned down and away.

subject: agriculture
title: Hand trowel
purpose: Moves small quantities of soil for planting or sampling.
howToUse: Use clean trowel for consistent sample depth.
safety: Avoid contaminated or sharp debris.

subject: agriculture
title: Soil auger
purpose: Collects soil cores from particular depths.
howToUse: Sample multiple representative locations using cleaned tools.
safety: Check for buried services before sampling.

subject: agriculture
title: Soil pH meter
purpose: Estimates acidity or alkalinity in a prepared soil sample.
howToUse: Use manufacturer-specified slurry and calibration.
safety: Moisture and electrode condition affect readings.

subject: agriculture
title: Seed tray
purpose: Holds seedlings in separate cells.
howToUse: Use clean medium and label crop or variety.
safety: Avoid waterlogging.

subject: agriculture
title: Watering can
purpose: Applies water gently to nursery beds.
howToUse: Use a rose head for even watering.
safety: Overwatering can limit soil aeration.

subject: agriculture
title: Weighing scale
purpose: Measures harvested material or feed mass.
howToUse: Zero container and record calibrated mass.
safety: Keep within scale capacity.

subject: agriculture
title: Knapsack sprayer
purpose: Applies liquids in agricultural settings.
howToUse: Use only authorised products, labelled rates and appropriate supervision.
safety: Chemical exposure requires training and approved PPE; no application advice here.

subject: agriculture
title: Soil sampling bag
purpose: Holds identified field soil samples.
howToUse: Label plot, depth, date and source before storage.
safety: Keep samples uncontaminated.

subject: agriculture
title: Rain gauge
purpose: Collects precipitation for rainfall measurement.
howToUse: Place upright in an unobstructed location and read depth consistently.
safety: Check placement and accumulation intervals.
